messages:
Maria: FYI — spotted a sharp usage drop for QuantEdge. 7d token delta ~ -62% (420k -> 160k). Renewal is 30 days out. Procurement contact changed to 'Samir Patel, VP Product' per last email. Customer mentioned a pilot with a vendor during a mailing list post. Flagging as renewal risk, need quick triage. @Alex can you confirm your contact notes?

Alex: Saw this in the CRM notes — Samir surfaced cost concerns and asked for a cost/perf baseline last week. He didn't name the vendor on the call. I've got a check-in scheduled Thurs 10am PT. I can push for clarity then. Will we have anything to show?

Jamal: Infra check: no errors, no rate-limit spikes. Their requests/day dropped, not our failures. I pulled key-level activity — they have 2 API keys; key B shows zero requests since 3/10. Could be product routing or a toggle.

Jamal: quick snippet of what I ran:
```
# recent usage by key (last 14d)
KEY_A: 1,120,432 tokens
KEY_B: 14,200 tokens
```

Priya: If they're testing alternatives we should move fast on perceived value. Suggested actions: 1) short 60-90m technical workshop for their PMs/engineers, 2) a focused cost dive (token/latency tradeoffs + caching suggestions), 3) offer a 2-week low-cost pilot config (quantized model + aggressive prefix caching). I can draft slides/agenda.

Maria: Proposed mitigation playbook: 1) Schedule exec touch with Samir + champion to re-anchor renewal timeline (Alex) 2) Technical workshop next week (Priya) 3) Run quick A/B: current model vs. cost-optimized variant for subset of traffic (Jamal to confirm feasibility) 4) Deliver ROI snapshot for the last 90d vs. projected with optimizations.

Alex: I'll take exec touch. Maria — can you compile usage trend + top 3 incidents/SLAs last 90d for the deck? Priya will run workshop invite once I confirm stakeholders. Jamal, can you validate A/B feasibility and any infra risks for toggling models?

Jamal: A/B is doable. We'll need a feature-flag on their side or a routing rule on ours. No infra changes needed; just config and a short QA window. ETA: 48hrs to get routing + monitoring in place.

Maria: I'll assemble the usage + SLA artifacts by EOD. Draft outreach below for Alex to send:
"Hi Samir — noticed drop in API usage and wanted to check in before your renewal. Can we set 30m to align on usage drivers? We can also run a low-cost pilot and a short tech workshop to validate perf/cost options"

Alex: Sending that after I prep with the exec points. Aim to lock meeting for Thurs.

oncall-bot: Reminder set: QuantEdge renewal triage check-in scheduled for 1765084800 (2026-03-24T16:00:00Z).

Maria: Quick follow — add a slide comparing our optimized per-token cost (with suggested caching/quantization) vs. a generic competitor uplift (estimate +25%). Priya will own the numbers. :thumbsup:

Priya: Got it, will have preliminary numbers and a 60m workshop agenda by tomorrow.

Alex: Thanks team — action owners: Alex (exec), Maria (usage deck), Priya (workshop & cost), Jamal (A/B + routing). Reporting back in this thread after Thurs call. :rocket:
